description: Stale report: a duplicate image link is hidden from screen readers and already out of the tab order. The titled link beside it is the one users reach.

issue.help: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements
issue.failureSummary:
Fix all of the following:
  Focusable content should have tabindex="-1", be removed from the DOM, or not be hidden with aria-hidden
